meta.sourceName: City of Toronto A - Z list of Licensed Child Care Centres
meta.headline: Licensed child care
meta.lede: Every centre linked from the City of Toronto A–Z list on 2 October 2026. Search by name, street, school, phone, or language, or start from a postal code.
meta.vacancyHint: A short misspelling of a longer word still matches. Vacancy text is the snapshot from 2 October 2026.
meta.postalHint: A full code such as A1A 1A1 measures from that one point. The first three characters, A1A, measure from the nearest point in that area. Spaces and capital letters do not matter.
meta.footer: This is not a City of Toronto website. Centre details were copied from published pages. Vacancy text is that snapshot. Call the centre for a current opening.
meta.areaIntro: Ward names are the words printed on each centre page.
meta.programIntro: Program names are copied from the centre pages. A centre can appear under more than one program.
meta.mapLede: Each dot is an address point for a licensed centre. Colour follows the highest published program rating. The base map is OpenFreeMap, using OpenStreetMap data.
meta.statArea: ward names on the published pages
meta.ratingFine: A rating link opens the City’s Assessment for Quality Improvement page for that program. “Not published” means that cell on the centre page was not a number. The City minimum is 3.
meta.detailsFine: The source prints this note under those lists: “This information has been provided by the child care. Please contact the centre for the most current information.”
meta.ecbLabel: Every Child Belongs resource consultation staff

about.lede: A readable copy of the City of Toronto A–Z list of licensed child care centres. It is not a City of Toronto website, and it does not take registrations.

sections.title: Where the pages came from
paragraphs: This database contains every centre linked from the City of Toronto A-Z list of Licensed Child Care Centres on the retrieval date. It does not include licensed home child care agencies. Those agencies are a separate City list. The pages were retrieved on 2 October 2026 (2026-10-02 23:04:13 UTC). Each page in that copy said it was last updated on September 26, 2026.

sections.title: Ratings
paragraphs: The Early Learning and Care Assessment for Quality Improvement rates items on a scale of 1 to 5, where 5 is the highest rating. To meet City of Toronto standards, a minimum of 3 is required.
Child care centres that do not have a service agreement with the City are not assessed for quality and therefore will not have a quality rating.
729 of 1,123 centres in this copy have at least one numeric rating.

sections.title: Vacancies, fees, and CWELCC
paragraphs: Vacancy, fee subsidy, and Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care text are the words printed on the centre page at retrieval. Vacancies change. Call the centre before you rely on an opening.

links.label: Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care

sections.title: Distance
paragraphs: The search box accepts a Canadian postal code in any mix of capital and small letters, with or without spaces. A full code, such as A1A 1A1, is one point in the Toronto-area postal file. Distance is the straight line from that point to the address point for the street address on the centre page.

The first three characters, such as A1A, search that whole area. Distance is then the straight line to the nearest postal-code point inside the area, so a centre in the area is not measured from the middle of it. Four or five characters are not used until the code is finished or shortened back to three.
Centre pages in this list do not publish a postal code. The postal code shown on a centre, when one is close enough, is the nearest point in the postal-code file.
City of Toronto Address Points, One Address Repository, layer cot_geospatial27/FeatureServer/101

GeoNames CA_full postal-code coordinates, https://download.geonames.org/export/zip/CA_full.csv.zip. The nearest postal-code point to the City address point is stored. City child-care pages do not publish a postal code.

sections.title: What you can open
paragraphs: Search, the map, wards, programs, and each centre use the data for Toronto. The same pages open any other Canadian city listed in the header. A centre link keeps the city and the centre id, so it can be shared on its own.
